notes: Ling-3.0-tiny Q8_0 through llama-swap (id ling-3.0-tiny-q8_0): stock llama.cpp, 131072 ctx, -ngl 99, -fa on, -b 1024 -ub 512, KV f16 (not q8_0 -- MLA needs matching K/V types and this build's flash-attn kernels for the 576-wide MLA head are f16-only; ~1.6 GiB of KV at full ctx). Normal ~15s load, not a PolyStrata cold start. Sampling is the model card's own (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, min_p 0) and is what models.json sends, so the table reads 'request'. Thinking level is 'high', not 'xhigh': the model entry carries no thinkingLevelMap, so xhigh/max are unsupported and would just clamp to high.

weights.caveat: the gguf declares no parameter count; its general.size_label is the string '128x1.0B', which is an expert layout, not a count. Architecture is 18 KDA linear-attention + 6 MLA blocks.
